title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Hardship Relief on Arrangement Deposits
content:
**Assistance program clause.** Hardship points are taken off the deposit percentage of an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility arrangement deposit while the account's hardship approval is in force — that is, while fewer than 12 whole calendar months (the hardship approval term of every payer class) have passed between the hardship approval date and the handling date.

| Hardship tier on the coverage record, approval in force | Points taken off the deposit percentage |
|---|---|
| full-100 | 4 |
| partial-75 | 4 |
| partial-50 | 4 |
| partial-25 | 2 |
| no approval in force (tier none, or approval 12 or more whole months old) | 0 |

The points lower the deposit percentage itself, applied once to the balance.

**Cases (hypothetical).**

- Tier partial-50, approved 3 whole months ago: 4 points off.
- Tier partial-25, approved 11 whole months ago: 2 points off.
- Tier partial-75, approved 12 whole months ago: the approval is no longer in force; none off.
